title: AutoPay Relief on Graduated-Return Lines (Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit)
content:
**Rule.** For a graduated-return line on a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a loan with AutoPay enrolled, with at least one AutoPay debit posted and none returned in the twelve months before the line is scheduled, takes 4 points off the share of the step up charged; a loan with AutoPay enrolled and at least one returned AutoPay debit in those twelve months takes 2 points off it; any other loan, including one enrolled with no AutoPay debit posted in those months, takes none, a debit counting as inside those twelve months when fewer than twelve whole calendar months separate its date from the day the line is scheduled. Enrollment and AutoPay debits are read from the loan's Personal Loans record and payment ledger.

## Truth table (within the twelve months)

| AutoPay enrolled | AutoPay debit posted | AutoPay debit returned | Points off the share |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | at least one | none | 4 |
| yes | any | at least one | 2 |
| yes | none | none | none |
| no | any | any | none |

*Hypothetical edge:* line scheduled on 5 June; an AutoPay debit dated 6 June of the previous year is inside the twelve months, one dated 5 June of the previous year is outside.
